headline: EMC’s -50.00% plunge on 7.51x volume is the most urgent name, while PROPERTY leads the upside with RML, CGD, and ORI drawing unusual trading activity.
market_take: Coverage was mixed, with sharp downside in EMC, KC, and PF and stronger momentum across several PROPERTY names. Unusual-trading alerts were concentrated in CONS and PROP, led by EMC’s volume and price shocks, ANAN’s 10.9σ volume spike, and ORI’s 5.2σ spike. Filings add company-specific focus in FOOD, PROP, and CONMAT, including TPOLY’s disclosed debenture interest default and DCON’s connected-transaction clarification.

sector_notes.note: RML rose +12.50%, CGD +11.11%, and ORI +5.29%, with unusual-trading alerts for each. ORI traded at 3.96x its usual volume, while ANAN also had a +6.06% open gap and a 10.9σ volume spike.

EMC fell -50.00% on 7.51x volume, the sharpest move in the digest, and KC fell -33.33%. TPOLY also triggered a -10.00% open gap and +11.11% intraday move, alongside a filing reporting default on debenture interest payment.

F&D fell -12.43% and was among the largest five-day decliners at -19.1%, while NRF rose +9.52%. TU and ITC filed acquisition-related disclosures, and BTG’s 6.4σ volume spike followed its filing on acquiring shares in an indirect subsidiary.

CCP had a -7.14% open gap, while DCON had a +6.67% open gap followed by a -6.25% intraday move. DCON also filed a clarification concerning the reasons and necessity for requesting Prinsiri Public Company Limited to convene.
